changed: The text changed since the preview: preview again to create it.
fixAndPreview: Fix the text and preview again.

namesMatched: Names are matched when the bill is created; unknown ones become new people.
noteParts: Parts split a line: “2 @boris” pays twice as much as “1 @anna”.
notePeople: People: @username, a contact’s name, a phone or an email.
noteSections: Sections are separated by one empty line.
nothingSaved: Nothing is saved until you create the bill.
subtitle: Paste a bill in the bot’s text format, check the preview, then create it.
